title: Next.js (React), Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui, Vitest, Playwright
stack: - Node.js LTS (version in `.nvmrc` and `package.json` → `engines`); npm with `package-lock.json`
- Next.js (App Router) and React; TypeScript or JavaScript is an ADR before ENV-01
- UI: Tailwind CSS with shadcn/ui (Radix); forms with react-hook-form and zod
- Data: an ADR before ENV-01 (a front end for an existing API, called from the server, or full stack with its own database)
- Tests: Vitest with React Testing Library (unit and components), Playwright (end to end)
- Error monitoring (Sentry or another) only when an ADR adds it
openChoices: the data: a front end for an existing API, or full stack with its own database (which database and ORM)
skeleton: `npx create-next-app@latest <temporary folder>` (the language from the ADR, ESLint, Tailwind CSS, App Router, `src/` folder), then move its files here, leaving its `node_modules/` and `.next/` behind: keep the kit's `README.md`, `CLAUDE.md` and `CHANGELOG.md`; delete the generator's agent files (`AGENTS.md` and its `CLAUDE.md`): the kit's `CLAUDE.md` guides the agent, and adding the generator's agent tooling is an ADR; add its `.gitignore` lines to the kit's `.gitignore`, and its `.gitattributes` lines to the kit's except a `* text=…` line (it would override the kit's line endings). Set `name` in `package.json` to the project's code name in kebab case (the generator takes the folder's name), write `.nvmrc` (the Node major) and run `npm install`. Then `npx shadcn@latest init`; add Vitest: `npm install -D vitest jsdom @testing-library/react @testing-library/dom @vitest/coverage-v8 @types/node@^<the .nvmrc major>` (the generator's older `@types/node` blocks the install), a `vitest.config` with the jsdom environment and the `@` alias, one component test, and the scripts `"test": "vitest run"` and `"lint": "eslint ."`.
codeConventions: - Server Components by default; `"use client"` only where state, effects or browser APIs need it.
- Validate every input at the boundary with zod: forms, route handlers, server actions and API responses.
- Secrets and API keys only on the server (`server-only`, environment variables without `NEXT_PUBLIC_`); `.env.example` lists every key.
- ESLint (Next config) passes before every commit.
- No hard-coded UI strings: message files, so another language can be added later; right-to-left layouts use logical classes (`ms-`, `me-`, `start-`, `end-`).
commands: - Test: `npm test` (Vitest); end to end: `npx playwright test`
- Lint and build: `npm run lint`, `npm run build`
testing: Unit and components: Vitest with React Testing Library (`npm test` runs `vitest run`), for rules, hooks, zod schemas and components with logic.
API calls: mocked at the network boundary in unit tests (a fake `fetch` or MSW); the real API only in end-to-end tests.

End to end: Playwright for the main flow of each requirement, against `npm run build` and `npm start`; before a release and in CI once ENV-02 sets it up, not in the pull request checks unless an ADR adds it.
Requirement ID in the test name: `it('ORD-01: shows the test location', …)`, so `npm test -- -t ORD-01` runs one requirement.
Coverage (when `delivery.coverage` is set): the `@vitest/coverage-v8` package; without it Vitest stops and the check fails.
runSteps:
1. Install Node.js (the version in `.nvmrc`).
2. `npm ci`
3. Copy `.env.example` to `.env.local` and fill it.
4. `npm test`
5. `npm run dev`, then open http://localhost:3000.
